description: Retrieve a single EU trademark by its application or registration number from the EUIPO — "look up EUTM 018123456". Returns the full record (mark text, status, owner/representative, Nice classes, goods & services, filing/registration/expiry dates) plus raw. Example: euipo_trademark({ number: "018123456", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

number.description: EUTM application or registration number, e.g. "018123456".

name: euipo_trademark
